notes.title: New Mine Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40037737/5e803d9a00b84924daf771aeb523fb884797a27b.png[/img]
This update provides many updates and quality of life improvements as well as an all new Mine to explore! This also adds a little bit of chill action... if that's something you're interested in.
[list]
[*]A Brand new mine in the upper part of your orchard! You can collect gems, fiber and coin! There are also a few new rare decorations for your farm that can be found! But be careful, there are aggressive bats and skeletons!
[*]I've reworked the inventory to be a little more informative.
[*]I have also redone how selling works! You can now sell more things at your mailbox.
[*]Other bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: NPC Tasks and Mini Games!
notes.notes:
Do daily tasks for the villagers in Little Town to build a relationship with each of them to gain access to their houses and 5 unique mini games!

notes.title: Halloween 2022 content!
notes.notes: Create a creepy cemetery, place pumpkins around your orchard or set up a bat house with this all new content! As an added bonus you can do all of this as a cute little ghost!

notes.title: Chickens in Bit Orchard!
notes.notes:
There's a new traveling salesman in town! He has everything you need to start raising chickens and selling eggs and mayonnaise! 

You can start with an egg and an incubator... then when the egg hatches you'll have a cute little chick wandering around! Once it grows into a chicken you might want to get a chicken coop so it'll start raising eggs!

With those eggs you do what anyone would do... make lemonade! Wait... no, I mean mayonnaise! You can sell that to the salesman for a profit, or keep it as a cute decoration!

I'm really excited for you to try out this latest expansion! If you like it(or not) feel free to rate Bit Orchard!

notes.title: Grid mode, Transparent trees and more!
notes.notes:
This update includes a bunch of fun stuff!
[list]
[*]Grid mode for fine tuning your seed planting! (turn it on or off in the options)
[*]Transparent Trees! Your apple trees will become transparent when you are behind them!
[*]Expanding your property and fixing the bridge are slightly cheaper now!
[*]Several Bug Fixes! The Scarecrow in the North West Corner can now be moved, some general improvements for picking things up, the Frog may be slightly easier to catch, and a bunch more tiny stuff.

notes.title: Bit Orchard - Major Expansion!
notes.notes:
To the far right of your little orchard is a broken bridge that opens up a small world of fun! Once you cross that bridge you'll have access to the lucrative world of fishing! 

There's even a small town with NPCs that need your help! And you can expect to be rewarded for your troubles!

Don't forget to visit the store frequently for a rotating selection of decorations to spice up your orchard! Also check out the all new player outfits!

And mixed into all of this is a fun little story for you to uncover!

I'm really excited for you to play all of this content that I've spent the past year on! I hope you enjoy it as much as I do!

[previewyoutube=_O3RVJwoBbQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
We have fixed an audio issue that's been plaguing the Orchard for months! Switching between tools should now make a sound! Oh, and the frog makes noise!
A glitch that would occasionally cause opening the closet to crash the game has hopefully been fixed as well as some visual improvements to the buttons.
An issue with one of the frogs gifts that prevented it from being carried has been fixed.
Restarting your farm is now harder to do on accident. 
It seems like a river has popped up to the east of the farm... I wonder what that means for future updates. Only time will tell, or you could follow us on Instagram @2BooneGames

notes.title: Colors Update!
notes.notes:
Don't want to look at the default color inspired by the original Gameboy any longer? You're in luck! You now have 8 unique color options to choose from!
Ever since I first started showing off my game people wanted more colors! This was by far the biggest feature request... well I am happy to answer this request!
I truly hope you enjoy this new feature as much as I do!
[previewyoutube=IT9G8oDh1gw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Bit Orchard Release
notes.notes:
The time has finally come! Bit Orchard will be released Wednesday May 19th!
Plant and water seeds, sell apples, befriend a rabbit and expand/decorate your apple orchard! 
Make sure to share screenshots of your farm with me on Instagram and Twitter @2BooneGames!
I can't wait for all of you to finally get to play my game. I really hope you enjoy it!
